facts.fact: Pet 在淤泥中已失视觉与绳线，伸手摸索 Jade、Flint 和黄绳
facts.anchor: I feel around with both hands, trying to find Jade, Flint, the yellow string

facts.fact: 拟态的 Jade 拉住 Pet 的手带路，Pet 怀疑是海怪诱饵仍跟上
facts.anchor: She tugs on my hand, leading us away from here.

facts.fact: 假 Jade 抢下 Pet 的咬嘴往外拽，冷水冲上他的脸
facts.anchor: Not-Jade grabs my mouthpiece and starts to pull it out.

facts.fact: Jade 用刀贴上 Pet 的脸颊，把 mindripper 从他脸上割下来
facts.anchor: Jade takes out her knife, bringing it up to my cheek.

facts.fact: Pet 与 Jade 各抓 mindripper 一端反向猛拽，把它撕成两半
facts.anchor: The little monster rips in half down the center, spilling purple guts

facts.fact: 洞角 “two other divers” 被 mindripper 裹面呼吸，Pet 点头后 Jade 用刀刺死两只
facts.anchor: She jabs both of the mindrippers with her knife without hesitation.

facts.fact: Jade 说她游了 “two hours” 找 Pet，一路系住绳子标记已搜过的区域
facts.anchor: I swam for two hours searching for you, tying off the line

facts.fact: Pet 循紧急定位器的 Ping 声找到 Flint，破出水面就抱住他
facts.anchor: Before my head breaks the surface, I throw my arms around him.
